content: Client clocks can drift ~50ms per 10 minutes and vary by device/network; the standard fix for speed-based scoring is a server-authoritative clock: server timestamps 'round start' and 'answer received' server-side, and only uses client-reported time as a hint, never as truth. NTP-style handshake (client sends T1 wallclock + estimated game time T2; server compares) is the common drift-correction protocol referenced in multiplayer game dev discussions.
